Name: Jerky Time
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
Back on my bullshit with a mod that adds a bunch of jerky type things to make with dehydrators, and some new dehydrators too.

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]
Two new dehydrators, a cheaper slower [b]Solar Dehydrator[/b] that must be used outside, and a more expensive faster [b]Commercial Dehydrator[/b] that must be used indoors. All new dehydrator items added by this mod should also work in the vanilla one at normal speed, and the vanilla items should cook in these new machines at their respective rates. Vanilla items will even slightly alter the graphics of the new machines, so grapes will look purple in the machine and so on. The Commercial one should theoretically be able to cook like three or four items a day.

With these you'll be able to make new jerky items from all the meats from vanilla and the following mods

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28023]Rose's Cruelty Free Meat[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22597]Dwarven Expansion - Animal Husbandry Patch
[/url]﻿[color=#f6b26b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25028][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru/mods]Mizu's Animal Mods[/url][/color]
[color=#f6b26b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25028][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3634]Trent's New Animals[/url][/color]

And also my mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24869]Pac-Man Fruit Ghosts[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30907]Livestock Dinosaurs[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38732]Dogs of The SNES[/url]﻿ (no dog meat in that, this just lets you make Doggy Jerky in the Dog Treat Press)

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30663]Milk of Myth Expanded[color=#616161] [/color][/url]is not natively supported by this mod, sorry. Feel free to make your own addon if you'd like, you're welcome to recolor the art assets or whatnot.

Anything else tagged as a meat_item should make a generic color inherited jerky. Milk of Myth meats will probably work, for example.

Fish that are not otherwise given their own jerky will also turn into generic color inherited Fish Jerky. Should work with tagged mod fish too. Should.

You'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] as well for the cooking recipes to work. Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿. As always, could be issues with balance and details, let me know if you experience issues or have feedback. Thanks as always to modding pals in the discords for helping me stumble my way through the JSON mines.

Latest version should be more flexible with which mods you do or don't have installed. Should be able to do most of the mod without AHM, for example. Let me know if you find any combos that cause issues I missed.
